{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "fanquake",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "reported thread start/exit logs spamming until rate-limited"
    },
    {
      "login": "andrewtoth",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "tested and measured speedups on IBD and reindex-chainstate, ACKed, and reviewed revisions"
    },
    {
      "login": "w0xlt",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "pointed out prefetched blocks on an invalid branch remain in memory indefinitely"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:5326868873",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Thread start and exit logging spams debug logs until rate-limiting kicks in",
      "quote": "Note that this spams ` blockread.* thread start/exit` debug logs to the point that rate-limiting kicks",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author kept fetcher alive on Chainstate in a follow-up push",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3806893819"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3806893819",
      "status_by_quote": "I’ve pushed a fix that keeps it alive on `Chainstate`"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3838749173",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Prefetch the fork index sibling block while disconnecting the old tip during reorgs",
      "quote": "We can make this useful for reorgs here by checking if the `pindexFork` is not our current tip, then clearing the prefetch queue and start fetching from the fork index.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author cleared previous followups and prefetched from first sibling during reorg disconnect",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3865838785",
        "r:5015013223"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3865838785",
      "status_by_quote": "Before disconnecting the current tip, activation now clears followups for the previous candidate and fills the queue from the first sibling."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3846417903",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Use a sliding window for the queue instead of waiting until empty to refill",
      "quote": "I think this method might be more efficient as a sliding window rather than just adding all pending tasks only when the validation thread has emptied the queue.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author implemented sliding queue refill in FillQueue",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3849625433",
        "r:5015013223"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3849625433",
      "status_by_quote": "FillQueue() (renamed) now starts from the number of queued followups and fills every missing slot."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3882096112",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Extract BlockFetcher into src/node/blockfetcher.h to allow index reuse",
      "quote": "What if we moved this out into a header in `src/node/blockfetcher.h`, and allowed passing the thread name in the constructor?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author moved BlockFetcher to src/node/blockfetcher.{h,cpp}",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3883186678"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3883186678",
      "status_by_quote": "I moved `BlockFetcher` into `src/node/blockfetcher.{h,cpp}` in this push"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3925912202",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Use multi-Submit overload when submitting tasks to wake threads at once",
      "quote": "maybe we can take advantage of the multi-`Submit` overload whenever we have an empty `m_followups`?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author batched missing read submissions",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4109704651",
        "rc:4128364452"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4128364452",
      "status_by_quote": "missing reads now use it, including refills of a partly drained queue."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3925912202",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Add a configuration option or toggle to disable read-ahead for low-memory systems",
      "quote": "we might want to allow disabling this mechanism for low memory systems. Maybe worth it to just be an on/off toggle (that defaults to on)?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added -blockreadahead=<n> setting where 0 disables it",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4109704651",
        "c:5841932189"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4109704651",
      "status_by_quote": "added `-blockreadahead=<n>` with a default of 2 readers and a queue capacity of `2*n` blocks. Setting it to `0` disables read-ahead."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3961053570",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Update stale release notes to mention multiple worker threads",
      "quote": "The release notes are stale. There are now multiple threads.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author updated release notes",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5824292936"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5824292936",
      "status_by_quote": "the release note says “threads,”"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4028286722",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Prefetched blocks for an invalid branch stay in memory indefinitely",
      "quote": "When a block was rejected, blocks read ahead for its branch could remain in memory indefinitely.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author cleared prefetched descendants for invalid blocks",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5824292936"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5824292936",
      "status_by_quote": "an invalid block clears prefetched descendants"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4117753017",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "Bound the configuration argument to a maximum value",
      "quote": "We should bound this to a max value, no?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author capped readers at 16 per chainstate",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4128356199",
        "rc:4129346786"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4128356199",
      "status_by_quote": "Pushed a cap of 16 readers per chainstate."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4117754011",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Add the setting to the reduce memory usage documentation",
      "quote": "Should we also add this to the reduce memory usage docs?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author updated docs to cover cap and queue capacity",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4128354952"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4128354952",
      "status_by_quote": "It was already there, but I updated it in the latest push to cover the cap and queue capacity."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4117781731",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Remove line that appears to be a no-op",
      "quote": "I don't see the purpose of this line. Seems like it will always be a no-op. I think it should be removed.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author removed the redundant line as FillQueue handles cleanup",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4128353965"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4128353965",
      "status_by_quote": "FillQueue now handles cleanup when the read-ahead range ends, so it isn't needed anymore."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4117857040",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Pass read_ahead_tip instead of time_point to ConnectTip to avoid adjusting timing variables",
      "quote": "Instead of passing a `time_point`, could we pass `const CBlockIndex* read_ahead_tip`?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author moved loading and refilling into ConnectTip to preserve timing variables",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4128325049"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4128325049",
      "status_by_quote": "Loading and refilling now happen inside `ConnectTip`, keeping the existing timing variables."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "r:5002610357",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "The benchmarks look promising.",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "tested",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5145580346",
      "verdict": "ACK",
      "reason": "Managed to see speedup in IBD benchmarks by having one local node bind to 10 ports and the other connect to all 10. I did this and reindex-chainstate with an i7 and i5 machine. Nice speedups, especially for reindex-chainstate. This will also be good for the typical single block reorg during tip, and we can use it almost verbatim for speeding up our optional index syncing in a follow-up.",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "both",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5332980784",
      "verdict": "",
      "reason": "I measured reindex-chainstate again with this latest commit and it's a blistering 1h 48m.",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "both",
      "areas": []
    }
  ],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "andrewtoth to re-review after the latest push addressed review comments and added reader cap",
      "id": "r:5346211447"
    },
    {
      "on": "author",
      "what": "promised benchmark results for batched task submissions",
      "id": "rc:4128364452"
    }
  ],
  "notes": "All four review suggestions from andrewtoth on 2026-09-28 have been addressed and fixed in the author's latest push and replies. Added previously unrecorded suggestions from earlier discussion under the re-read rules."
}

support.reason: Managed to see speedup in IBD benchmarks by having one local node bind to 10 ports and the other connect to all 10. I did this and reindex-chainstate with an i7 and i5 machine. Nice speedups, especially for reindex-chainstate. This will also be good for the typical single block reorg during tip, and we can use it almost verbatim for speeding up our optional index syncing in a follow-up.
I measured reindex-chainstate again with this latest commit and it's a blistering 1h 48m.
